filed_under: research/results/h1-* only because research/tests/test_prereg.py maps every MANIFEST file to one hypothesis's results glob; the result decides no hypothesis
limits: One hand-written workload of sixteen steps (fifteen writes, one of them to a team scope, and one read) at one clock; the opt-outs are three, chosen to exercise a topic, a source with a carve-out and a window with a carve-out.

A topic matches whole words of the content (policy/consent.ts); a paraphrase that names no word of the topic is not refused, and a write naming the topic in passing is. The workload shows both on purpose. Known evasions, not closed: plurals and inflections, an accent inside a word, joined compounds and camelCase, a digit glued to a word, letters split by spaces or dots, homoglyphs NFKC does not fold, a topic split across two writes, and case folding beyond lower case. Consent is a control a cooperative writer meets, not a filter an adversarial writer cannot evade.

An echo is counted when a string of the refused content longer than twelve characters appears in the refusal's reason; the reason is also checked by the property test packages/core/test/property/consent.test.ts with a nonce in every content.

A window is judged at the time a write reaches the plane: what is produced during an Incognito window and written after it (a store record adopted later, a session distilled or consolidated later) is judged then, and the pi session tree is not under the gate.
name: consent-gate
wording: a recorded workload of fifteen writes by a person, her tools and her agent (and one read) replayed by engram simulate under the twin profile and under the twin profile with three opt-outs of her person scope: the writes each policy allowed and denied, the consent refusals by opt-out, how many name their opt-out and how many repeat the refused content. A proof of concept on a fixture workload with no model in the loop, never a hypothesis result
